messages.author: a1919e07d994b729
messages.subject: Problem on developing APP to shinyapps
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have a question realated to an application to shinyapps.io

the application works perfectly locally but when I deploy it to shinyapps while is charging the models it stops and disconnect from the server. It does not put any error on Rstudio log.

this is the URL: https://jlae.shinyapps.io/PredictorPCCCRCat/

anyone has an idea of what is happening?!

Thanks in advice

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problem on developing APP to shinyapps
parts:
Is it possible that your data model requires more memory than the instance size you have selected? I would try bumping that up and seeing if it resolves the issue.

Getting a message into the error log indicating that this is what is happening is high on the backlog, I am hoping we can get to it in the coming few months.
